universe: S1 candidates.json; one event per issuer per season; mid-season additions excluded (descriptive)
d_exp: from the season's S1 raw/nasdaq_calendar.json and raw/av_calendar.csv only; earliest in-window Nasdaq date, else earliest AV date; if both and they differ, the earlier
entry: close of E = shift(D_exp, -21); E's date must be strictly later than this file's freeze-commit ET date and the S1 capture commit date, else VOID window_not_open
d_act: company-confirmed date (confirm.json / event_status.json), else first Item 2.02 8-K accepted on/after shift(E,2); earlier if both
exit: close of X = min(shift(E,20), shift(D_act,-1)); VOID print_before_window if D_act <= shift(E,1); no D_act by shift(D_exp,30) -> X = shift(E,20), flag print_date_unknown
prices: yfinance adjusted close (auto_adjust=True), stock + SPY + D003 s8 ETF, fetched once >= 06:00 ET the session after X, write-once
excess_primary: r - beta*r_SPY; beta = OLS on 250 daily returns to close shift(E,-1), shrunk 0.67*beta+0.33; < 120 returns -> beta 1, flag beta_short
test: calendar-time equal-weight daily beta-adjusted excess series; circular block bootstrap, block 20, 9999 draws, demeaned null, seed sha256(test id); size gate <= 7% at 30/45/60 synthetic events else KV fixed-b NW lag 20 becomes primary
significance_requires: Holm p < 0.05 AND beta-1 and ETF point estimates not negative
verdict: once, A+B pooled, at the later of D009 v1 s5 Season B end and last SH-RU exit + 2 sessions; 'late-window reporters only'
implementation: hash + golden fixture + size-gate result registered in D009_implementation_v3.sha256 before the first X; no change after
